name: Dream of Rosy Pastries
source:
Set in the Victorian era. A girl wakes up in a mysterious place where plants grow pastries, tea bags instead of fruit. There she is greeted by creatures  who give her a warm welcome. Led by her curiosity, she is led to believe that this place is not what it seems.

[From [url=https://shrimpdolly25.itch.io/dream-of-rosy-pastries]Itch.io[/url]]
